title: aHomes
description: aHomes is a comprehensive home management plugin for Minecraft servers.
body:
### aHomes - Feature-Rich Home Management Plugin

**aHomes** is a powerful and modern home plugin for Minecraft servers. Create named homes, browse them with a beautiful GUI, customize warmups & cooldowns, share homes with friends, and enjoy full **Folia** support.

---

### Features

- **Named Homes** — Create unlimited (or rank-limited) homes with custom names
- **Beautiful GUI** — Sleek inventory interface to view, favorite, and teleport to your homes
- **Custom Warmups** — Configurable countdown with action bar progress
- **Cooldowns** — Prevent teleport spam with per-player or global cooldowns
- **Combat Protection** — Block teleporting while in combat (configurable)
- **Home Sharing** — Allow friends to teleport to your shared homes
- **Per-Player Settings** — Players can toggle sounds, action bar, GUI mode, coordinates, request popups, etc.
- **Admin Tools** — Powerful `/homeadmin` command for full management
- **Flexible Limits** — Permission-based home limits (`ahomes.limit.1`, `ahomes.limit.5`, `ahomes.limit.unlimited`, etc.)
- **World Control** — Disable homes in specific worlds
- **Hex Colors** — Full `&#RRGGBB` hex color support in messages and GUI

**Fully compatible with Paper, Purpur, and Folia** — Optimized for the latest threaded region system.

---

### Commands

| Command                        | Description                                      |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `/sethome [name]`             | Save current location as a home                  |
| `/home [name]`                | Teleport to one of your homes                    |
| `/homes`                      | Open the beautiful homes GUI                     |
| `/delhome <name>`             | Delete a home                                    |
| `/homesettings`               | Open personal settings menu                      |
| `/homeadmin <sub> <player> [home]` | Admin management command                  |

---

### Permissions

- `ahomes.use` — Basic usage (default: true)
- `ahomes.limit.X` — Set maximum number of homes (e.g. 1, 3, 5, 10, unlimited)
- `ahomes.admin` — Access to admin commands
- `ahomes.bypass.warmup` — Bypass warmup
- `ahomes.bypass.cooldown` — Bypass cooldown
- `ahomes.bypass.combat` — Bypass combat protection

---

### Why choose aHomes?

- Modern & clean codebase
- Excellent Folia/Paper performance
- Highly configurable
- Player-friendly GUI + settings
- Strong admin control

Perfect for Survival, SMP, and Network servers.
